title: Out-of-Area Tire Repair Reimbursement Under Road Hazard Protection
content:
## Scope
This governs a covered tire repair the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate paid a shop outside the Crestline network for, with the damage more than the plan's out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store and a repair receipt that covers the out-of-area repair reimbursement. Only such a repair is reimbursed at the out-of-area repair reimbursement here; every other out-of-area repair — a repair receipt that falls short of it among them — is reimbursed at the receipt amount up to the plan's out-of-area repair cap. Commercial use is judged on the service date.

**Receipt covers.** The repair receipt covers the out-of-area repair reimbursement when the amount the holder paid the outside shop on it is at least the out-of-area repair reimbursement.

**Out of area.** For such a repair the damage counts as out of area when the place of the repair, as the holder reads it from the shop's receipt, lies more than the plan's out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store. An out-of-area tire replacement reimbursed at the out-of-area reimbursement and an out-of-area tow reimbursed at the out-of-area tow reimbursement state their own out-of-area condition; every other out-of-area claim keeps the base out-of-area condition, that the damage occurred more than the out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store.

## Booking
An out-of-area repair is reimbursed only after the tow of the same breakdown carries its out-of-area tow reimbursement entry on the certificate, and the repair entry is booked under that tow entry's claim number.

The reimbursement is paid to the tender the certificate was bought with and booked as an out-of-area repair reimbursement entry on the certificate. It then counts toward the wheel position's covered repairs and the certificate's benefits paid.

## Invocation: `reimburse_hazard_outside_repair_444e27b0`
**Capability.** Books the reimbursement of a tire repair the holder paid an outside shop for while far from any Crestline store, under a given claim number. One call books one out-of-area repair reimbursement entry with the claim number, wheel position, damage, receipt date, amount reimbursed and tender.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**
- `hazard_certificate_id` — reference number of the certificate the repair is reimbursed under, as returned by the certificate lookup for this holder.
- `claim_number` — claim number to book the repair under, RHC- followed by 7 digits (for example RHC-0482913), as shown on a claim entry of the certificate.
- `tire_position` — wheel position of the repaired tire: one of `LF` (left front wheel), `RF` (right front wheel), `LR` (left rear wheel), `RR` (right rear wheel), `SP` (the matching full-size spare) or `none` (no wheel position applies to the entry).
- `damage_type` — damage on the receipt: one of `puncture_tread` (a puncture in the tread area), `puncture_shoulder` (a puncture in the shoulder), `sidewall_cut` (a cut or gash in the sidewall), `impact_break` (a break or bulge from an impact), `bead_damage` (damage at the bead) or `none` (no damage applies to the entry).
- `service_date` — date printed on the outside shop's receipt, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `amount` — amount reimbursed for the repair, USD to 2 decimal places.
- `payment_method` — tender the reimbursement is paid to: one of `none` (no tender applies), `cash_or_debit` (certificate paid in cash or by debit card), `bank_card` (paid with a bank-issued credit card), `crestline_card` (paid with a Crestline credit card) or `fleet_account` (charged to a Crestline fleet account).

**Return.** A line beginning "Reimbursed" gives the reimbursement entry reference, the claim number, the wheel position, the amount in USD to 2 decimal places and the tender; it means the repair is on the certificate.
